value.message: Riverbend Community Centre runs Parent & Tot Playtime for 12 months to 4 years, Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30-11:00 a.m., Sept 8 to Dec 11 - their site says. The price isn't posted; their page points to the front desk or a phone call for the fee. I'll keep watching and text you if that and registration details get posted.
